headline: FBI confirms ongoing FortiBleed attacks on FortiGate VPN devices
summary: The FBI confirmed that FortiBleed attacks remain ongoing, targeting exposed Fortinet FortiGate firewalls and SSL VPN gateways and locking out legitimate administrators. Reports cite tens of thousands more victims and growing involvement from ransomware groups.

claims.statement: The FBI confirms FortiBleed attacks against Fortinet FortiGate products are ongoing.
